 Will the nationwide ground stop bleed into the holiday season?
 By Molly Parks 
 Published
 November 16, 2026 1:30pm ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 On Friday, the Federal Aviation Administration declared the first nationwide ground stop since 2023, halting all U.S. flights for four hours and setting off a storm of flight delays just two weeks ahead of Thanksgiving.
 With the federal holiday and the busy travel season that comes with it just 10 days out, there are still lingering flight delays as airlines work to catch up and clear the backlog of residual delays and cancellations from Friday’s ground stop.
